crossRefs.note: Satan answered Yahweh, and said, “Skin for skin. Yes, all that a man has he will give for his life.
Then the mariners were afraid, and every man cried to his god. They threw the cargo that was in the ship into the sea…
For whoever wants to save his life will lose it; and whoever will lose his life for my sake and the sake of the Good…
For whoever desires to save his life will lose it, but whoever will lose his life for my sake, will save it.
For what does it profit a man if he gains the whole world, and loses or forfeits his own self?

translations.web: On the third day, they threw out the ship’s tackle with their own hands.
translations.bsb: On the third day, they threw the ship’s tackle overboard with their own hands.
translations.kjv: And the third day we cast out with our own hands the tackling of the ship.
translations.asv: and the third day they cast out with their own hands the tackling of the ship.
